stem: A room contains edge, center and multiple process zones. Which observation plan best reduces location sampling bias while remaining repeatable?
choices: Use the same convenient aisle on every walk so the sample is consistent over time
Use representative points across the defined route, including relevant edges, center positions and process zones, and record how many points were inspected
Inspect the zones with the most previous problems because they are most likely to show useful findings
Rotate to a different informal path each walk so every area eventually receives attention
rationale: Repeatability alone does not make a convenience sample representative. A defined route should cover relevant spatial/process areas and preserve the denominator so findings can be interpreted and compared over time.

extensions.sourceScope: Transferable greenhouse scouting and recordkeeping guidance; route details remain facility-specific.
